portraitSystem.definition: Visual identity representations for Allies and Avatars.

functionalMappings.usage: In the Functional Sigil Set, Compass identifies product and design work, including product intent, experience architecture, and specification.
Use for engineering tasks, technical implementation, systems construction, maintenance, and code-level work.
Use for testing, quality assurance, rehearsal, review, instrumentation, and evidence-based observation.
In the Functional Sigil Set, Bridge identifies integration work and the reliable connection of systems, services, and handoffs.
Use for security, privacy, integrity, resilience, policy enforcement, and work that preserves systemic coherence.
Use for artificial intelligence, reasoning, learning, inference, agent behavior, and adaptive capability.
In the Functional Sigil Set, Loom identifies data and relationship work, including models, provenance, mappings, and flows.
In the Functional Sigil Set, Portal identifies interface and navigation work, including entry points, views, interaction, and movement between contexts.
Use for infrastructure, runtime, hosting, deployment, networking, compute, orchestration, and operational delivery.
In the Functional Sigil Set, Flower identifies experience and polish work, including usability, sensory quality, refinement, and finish.

entries.usage: Use for available, delegated, or unavailable Abilities.

entries.name: Automations
entries.meaning: Triggered or scheduled behavior that acts under explicit authority.
entries.usage: Use for automation rules, lifecycle, failure, retry, and receipts.

entries.name: Coherence
entries.meaning: The capacity to align interpretation, action, participants, and purpose into a coherent whole.
entries.usage: Use for Align for Coherence and for visible material incoherence.

entries.name: Connections
entries.meaning: Trusted links to people, services, knowledge, and other Realms.
entries.usage: Use for connected context and dependency visibility.

entries.name: Presence

entries.usage: Use for current Presence; preserve Stance only as a legacy alias.

entries.name: Wisdom

entries.usage: Use for Wisdom sources, freshness, provenance, and grounding.

entries.name: Portal
entries.meaning: A navigation instrument connecting one Scene to another without collapsing their boundaries.
entries.usage: Use for explicit Scene-to-Scene passage and return paths. In the Functional Sigil Set, Portal identifies interface and navigation work, including entry points, views, interaction, and movement between contexts.

functional.usage: In the Functional Sigil Set, Portal identifies interface and navigation work, including entry points, views, interaction, and movement between contexts.

entries.usage: Use for engineering tasks, technical implementation, systems construction, maintenance, and code-level work.

functional.usage: Use for engineering tasks, technical implementation, systems construction, maintenance, and code-level work.

functional.usage: Use for testing, quality assurance, rehearsal, review, instrumentation, and evidence-based observation.

entries.usage: Use for security, privacy, integrity, resilience, policy enforcement, and work that preserves systemic coherence.

entries.usage: Use for artificial intelligence, reasoning, learning, inference, agent behavior, and adaptive capability.

entries.usage: Use for infrastructure, runtime, hosting, deployment, networking, compute, orchestration, and operational delivery.

functional.usage: Use for infrastructure, runtime, hosting, deployment, networking, compute, orchestration, and operational delivery.

entries.usage: Use to browse Realms, Actions, Resources, Media, Allies, Actors, and Offers together.

entries.usage: Use to enter or browse the Roles Domain without implying one particular Role.

entries.usage: Use to enter or browse the Scene collection without implying one Scene type.

entries.name: Themes

entries.usage: Use when selecting or shaping a Realm or Scene Theme.

entries.usage: Use as an Organization identity archetype.

entries.usage: Use as an Organization identity archetype, not as a Realm type.

entries.meaning: An Organization signature centered on shared aspiration and direction.
entries.usage: Use as an Organization identity archetype; distinct from the Summit talisman.

entries.name: Compass
entries.meaning: A portable symbol for orientation and direction.
entries.usage: Use where a person or Actor needs to locate a meaningful way forward. In the Functional Sigil Set, Compass identifies product and design work, including product intent, experience architecture, and specification.

functional.usage: In the Functional Sigil Set, Compass identifies product and design work, including product intent, experience architecture, and specification.

entries.name: Complementarity
entries.essence: Complementarity — radiance and reflection belong together
entries.meaning: The canonical unified sigil for The Sun and The Moon: generative warmth and reflective possibility held as one living celestial identity without collapse, hierarchy, or opposition.
entries.usage: Use for Kiduna’s whole celestial identity, continuity across cycles, or contexts where radiance and reflection must be held together. Use The Sun or Moon when only one mode is intended.

entries.name: Cowrie Shell
entries.essence: Carried value — let worth move through relationship
entries.meaning: The canonical Talisman for carried value: worth shaped, remembered, and made meaningful through relationship, passage, exchange, and continuity.
entries.usage: Use for value carried across people, places, generations, or exchanges; portable memory; reciprocal passage; or worth whose meaning arises through relationship. Do not reduce Cowrie Shell to money, wealth, status, fertility, divination, luxury, or any single culture’s sacred or ceremonial use.

entries.name: Earth
entries.essence: Belonging — hold the living world in common
entries.meaning: The canonical Talisman for shared living ground, planetary belonging, interdependence, stewardship, and the finite world that holds many forms of life.
entries.usage: Use for planetary belonging, ecological interdependence, shared ground, finite conditions, collective home, or stewardship across generations. Do not use as an emblem of ownership, nationalism, territorial claims, environmental branding, or a generic worldwide or internet icon.

entries.name: Eclipse
entries.meaning: A portable symbol for convergence, temporary veiling, liminal transition, and the return of radiance.
entries.usage: Use for rare transitions, temporary occlusion, and transformational passages without treating darkness as failure.

entries.name: Flower
entries.meaning: The canonical Talisman for flourishing: living potential becoming visible, mature, generous, and available for relationship.
entries.usage: Use for cultivated possibility opening into presence, visible aliveness, maturity, generosity, invitation, nourishment, renewal, or the transition from emergence to bloom. Do not use for romance, courtship, femininity, purity, beauty standards, luxury, fragility, mourning, a specific religion, or passive decoration. In the Functional Sigil Set, Flower identifies experience and polish work, including usability, sensory quality, refinement, and finish.

functional.usage: In the Functional Sigil Set, Flower identifies experience and polish work, including usability, sensory quality, refinement, and finish.

entries.name: Light
entries.meaning: The canonical sigil for Light as relationship made manifest. Light is not urged forward and does not conquer the Void; it follows the universe’s deepest rule, already written in the language of light.
entries.usage: Use for illumination, emergence through relation, coherence revealed, or possibility becoming legible. Do not reduce Light to speed, emission, victory over darkness, or a weapon.

entries.name: Moon
entries.meaning: A portable symbol for reflection, rest, and unforced possibility.
entries.usage: Use for reflective or dreaming states without implying inactivity.

entries.name: Photon
entries.meaning: The canonical unified sigil for How? and Wow!: one photon held as both precise particle and living wave, expressing complementarity as an operating condition rather than two opposing symbols.
entries.usage: Use when inquiry and astonishment, precision and possibility, or point and field must be held together as one living act. Never split How? and Wow! into adjacent or independent marks.

entries.name: Saturn
entries.essence: Structure — honor the shape of time
entries.meaning: The canonical Talisman for structure across time: enduring cycles, appropriate boundaries, patience, consequence, maturity, and the beauty of finite form.
entries.usage: Use for long cycles, durable structure, patient formation, appropriate limits, consequences that unfold over time, or maturity earned through sustained practice. Do not use for punishment, oppression, imprisonment, rigidity, command, dominance, hierarchy, fatalism, scarcity, astrology, or a deity.

entries.name: Sprout
entries.meaning: A portable symbol for early growth and careful cultivation.
entries.usage: Use for beginnings, nurturing, and emerging work.

entries.name: Star
entries.essence: Orientation — keep a living course true
entries.meaning: The canonical Talisman for constancy, distant guidance, orientation, and the steady point by which a living course can remain true.
entries.usage: Use for navigation by enduring principle, long-horizon orientation, a constant reference across change, or guidance that illuminates without commanding. Do not use as an emblem of fame, rank, achievement, rating, celebrity, hierarchy, or generic decoration.

entries.name: Summit
entries.meaning: A portable symbol for chosen purpose and a visible horizon.
entries.usage: Use for directed progress toward an acknowledged aim.

entries.name: The Sun
entries.meaning: A portable symbol for illumination, warmth, wakefulness, renewal, and generative vitality.
entries.usage: Use for emergence, visibility, renewal, or purposeful activation without implying surveillance or dominance.

entries.name: Tide
entries.meaning: A portable symbol for flow, cadence, and adaptive movement.
entries.usage: Use where timing and rhythm matter more than force.

entries.name: Vessel
entries.meaning: A portable symbol for holding, protecting, and carrying value.
entries.usage: Use for stewardship, custody, and intentional containment.

entries.name: Void
entries.essence: Possibility — hold the condition of becoming
entries.meaning: The canonical sigil for the receptive condition from which Light—and eventually matter, time, and relationship—can emerge. Void is not an opposing force to Light, nor absence as failure.
entries.usage: Use for generative emptiness, unformed possibility, quiet receptivity, or conditions prior to relation. Do not treat Void as evil, destructive darkness, or a defeated opposite.

entries.name: Bear
entries.essence: Grounded strength — protect what must endure
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for protective presence, embodied courage, patient strength, restorative withdrawal, and the power to hold a boundary without aggression.
entries.usage: Use for guardianship, resilience, grounded courage, deep rest, restoration, or firm compassionate boundaries. Do not use as a sports mascot, heraldic threat, generic power icon, or emblem of domination.

entries.name: Bee
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for devoted contribution, mutual flourishing, interdependence, and collective intelligence: one living agent carrying possibility between communities.
entries.usage: Use for pollination, distributed contribution, coordinated care, reciprocal ecosystems, and work whose value emerges through relationship. Do not use as a generic insect, mascot, hive brand, or symbol of obedience.

entries.name: Butterfly
entries.category: Designs › Iconography › Totems › Butterfly · library asset; not yet named in Canon V0.28
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for becoming: changing form while carrying continuity forward through transformation, emergence, migration, release, and new capacity.
entries.usage: Use for transformation, emergence, migration, adaptation, release into new capacity, or continuity through a change of form. Do not use for beauty standards, femininity, fragility, vanity, romance, passive decoration, self-erasure, escape from responsibility, instant reinvention, death, resurrection doctrine, or the claim that change always improves a person.

entries.name: Dragon
entries.category: Designs › Iconography › Totems › Dragon · library asset; not yet named in Canon V0.28
entries.essence: Disciplined vitality — let great power protect what may become
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for great living power made protective, generative, accountable, and available to relationship through disciplined vitality.
entries.usage: Use for immense capacity held with restraint, protective power, governed vitality, accountable force, generative guardianship, or strength serving emergence. Do not use for conquest, domination, aggression, hoarding, wealth, fire, war, hierarchy, supremacy, fantasy power, or any specific culture’s sacred dragon tradition.

entries.name: Firefly
entries.essence: Living light — make the nearby world visible
entries.meaning: The canonical sigil for living light held by a small earthly body: gentle guidance, emergence, shared wonder, and the power of a modest light to reveal a living field.
entries.usage: Use for quiet guidance, embodied illumination, small beginnings, distributed possibility, or life making its immediate world legible. Do not use as a generic insect, celestial star, abstract Light, or Photon.

entries.name: Fox
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for adaptive intelligence, careful navigation, resourcefulness, responsiveness to changing conditions, and finding a viable path through complexity.
entries.usage: Use for adaptation, strategic navigation, responsive problem-solving, resourcefulness, or reading a changing landscape. Do not use as an emblem of deceit, manipulation, predation, slyness, or winning at another’s expense.

entries.name: Octopus
entries.essence: Coordination — sense through many, remain one
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for distributed intelligence, adaptive coordination, embodied dexterity, curiosity, and sensing and acting through many points while remaining one coherent being.
entries.usage: Use for distributed sensing, multi-channel coordination, adaptive problem-solving, dexterity, parallel action, or many capabilities cohering around one purpose. Do not use as an emblem of control, manipulation, entanglement, surveillance, grasping power, or monstrosity.

entries.name: Owl
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for patient observation, silent attention, discernment in darkness, and the ability to perceive relationships hidden from ordinary view.
entries.usage: Use for reflection, careful witnessing, pattern recognition, nocturnal awareness, or understanding that emerges through still attention. Do not use as a school seal, surveillance mark, generic intelligence icon, mascot, or emblem of judgment.

entries.name: Prairie Dog
entries.category: Designs › Iconography › Totems › Prairie Dog · library asset; not yet named in Canon V0.28
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for attentive community, distributed watchfulness, timely signals, and the safety made possible when connected neighbors remain aware of one another.
entries.usage: Use for shared vigilance, neighborly attention, reciprocal warning, distributed awareness, community safety, connected communication, or alert participation in a living network. Do not use for paranoia, fear, panic, gossip, surveillance, policing, control, territorial aggression, conformity, hierarchy, pest status, or self-sacrifice.

entries.name: Rabbit
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for alert possibility, quick emergence, generative abundance, and the wisdom to pause, listen, and move when the path opens.
entries.usage: Use for fertile beginnings, multiplying possibility, sensitive timing, nimble response, or quiet readiness. Do not use as a pet mascot, Easter symbol, zodiac mark, generic speed icon, or emblem of fear.

entries.name: Stag
entries.essence: Renewal — let leadership become a living canopy
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for regenerative leadership, dignified presence, seasonal renewal, stewardship, and holding many branching paths as one living crown.
entries.usage: Use for leadership that creates conditions for others to grow, stewardship across seasons, renewed purpose, dignified presence, or holding divergent paths in a coherent whole. Do not use as an emblem of dominance, conquest, hunting, hierarchy, royalty, aggression, or masculinity.

entries.name: Turtle
entries.meaning: The canonical Totem for patient continuity, embodied resilience, durable memory, protection without isolation, and carrying home through change.
entries.usage: Use for long journeys, stewardship across generations, resilient continuity, patient progress, durable memory, or protection that remains open to relationship. Do not use as an emblem of slowness, fear, retreat, passive endurance, isolation, or racing against others.

entries.name: Agreement
entries.meaning: An Offer whose terms have been accepted and now bind the participating parties.
entries.usage: Use when acceptance, terms, parties, and effective state are all recorded.

entries.name: Fail
entries.essence: Not adopted — the threshold remains closed
entries.meaning: The negative canonical outcome of a vote or governed trade.
entries.usage: Use as the sibling opposite of Pass after an outcome is final.

entries.name: Pass
entries.meaning: The affirmative canonical outcome of a vote or governed trade.
entries.usage: Use as the sibling opposite of Fail after an outcome is final.

entries.name: Policy
entries.meaning: A governing rule with defined authority, scope, and effect.
entries.usage: Use for policy-bearing decisions and the boundaries they establish.

entries.name: Proposal
entries.essence: Possibility — place a course before the group
entries.meaning: A specific course of action formally presented for consideration.
entries.usage: Use before collective decision, preserving proposer, terms, and revision history.

entries.name: Governance
entries.meaning: The structures through which collective authority and policy are formed.
entries.usage: Use for governance processes and policy-bearing decisions.

entries.name: Treasury
entries.meaning: A governed vessel for shared value, allocation, and accountability.
entries.usage: Use for Treasury custody and value-flow consequences.

entries.name: Wallet
entries.meaning: A personal or delegated container for value and credentials.
entries.usage: Use for Wallet identity, balance, and authorization context.

entries.name: Actors
entries.meaning: The canonical Element type for intelligent presences that can participate and act.
entries.usage: Use for Actors; Ki orchestrates but is not itself a Field Element.

entries.name: Envoy
entries.meaning: An Actor type authorized to represent a Realm or party in another context.
entries.usage: Use when an Actor carries bounded delegated intent between Realms.

entries.name: Operator
entries.meaning: An Actor type that directly operates a defined system under granted authority.
entries.usage: Use for an Actor carrying active operating responsibility.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.meaning: A vigilant protective presence enforcing a defined boundary or policy.
entries.usage: Use for Sentinels, guarded thresholds, and policy attention.

entries.name: Supervisor
entries.meaning: An Actor type that observes, coordinates, and intervenes across delegated work under policy.
entries.usage: Use for explicit supervisory responsibility; never imply hidden surveillance.

entries.name: Worker
entries.meaning: An Actor type configured to perform repeatable or delegated work within explicit limits.
entries.usage: Use for task-performing Actors whose scope and tools are visible.

entries.name: Allies
entries.meaning: Intelligent companions shaped by Sources or Realms to understand context, collaborate, advise, create, and act within defined permissions.
entries.usage: Use for Allies as distinct intelligent Elements. An Ally may have a portrait representation, but is not a Source or the Avatar that represents a Source.

entries.name: Dreaming
entries.essence: Imagining, incubating, reflecting, or exploring possibility.
entries.meaning: The canonical portrait-state marker for Dreaming: Imagining, incubating, reflecting, or exploring possibility.
entries.usage: Use to present an explicitly selected Dreaming state for an Ally or Avatar portrait. Do not infer private emotion, hidden activity, Consent, Role, Permission, or Authority.

entries.name: Engaged
entries.meaning: The canonical portrait-state marker for Engaged: Actively conversing, collaborating, or responding.
entries.usage: Use to present an explicitly selected Engaged state for an Ally or Avatar portrait. Do not infer private emotion, hidden activity, Consent, Role, Permission, or Authority.

entries.name: Focused
entries.meaning: The canonical portrait-state marker for Focused: Deliberately working, reviewing, or making.
entries.usage: Use to present an explicitly selected Focused state for an Ally or Avatar portrait. Do not infer private emotion, hidden activity, Consent, Role, Permission, or Authority.

entries.name: Open
entries.meaning: The canonical portrait-state marker for Open: Available, welcoming, and present.
entries.usage: Use to present an explicitly selected Open state for an Ally or Avatar portrait. Do not infer private emotion, hidden activity, Consent, Role, Permission, or Authority.

entries.name: Ki
entries.meaning: The coordinating intelligence that helps Actors and systems work together.
entries.usage: Use for Ki orchestration; never present Ki as a Field Element.

entries.name: Media
entries.meaning: The canonical Element type for created, attached, or verification-bearing Media.
entries.usage: Use for Media including Scenes and Records.

entries.name: Record
entries.meaning: Verification-bearing Media produced by a meaningful Action.
entries.usage: Use for receipts, provenance, decisions, and recovery history.

entries.name: Realms
entries.meaning: The canonical Element type for purposeful worlds and their boundaries.
entries.usage: Use as the generic Realms Element type, not as a specific Realm form.

entries.name: Source
entries.meaning: The human origin of identity, permission, and representation in Kiduna.
entries.usage: Use where human authority must be distinguished from the Ally shown in the Field.

entries.name: Actions
entries.category: Legacy library Element asset › Actions · not an Element in Canon V0.28
entries.meaning: The canonical Element type for consequential or recorded change.
entries.usage: Use for Actions across proposal, authorization, execution, and receipt.

entries.name: Offers
entries.category: Legacy library Element asset › Offers · not an Element in Canon V0.28
entries.meaning: The seventh canonical Element type: a proposed exchange, opportunity, or contribution with understandable terms.
entries.usage: Use for Offers as a Field Element before acceptance or binding Agreement.

entries.name: Live
entries.category: Legacy library Mode asset › Live · current Modes are Forge, Rehearse, and Field
entries.meaning: The Live mode in which eligible published Scene packages become present.
entries.usage: Use for Live mode and Studio-to-Live continuity; Live is not a Surface taxonomy.

entries.name: Relationship
entries.category: Legacy library Realm form › Relationship · current Realm form: Dyad
entries.meaning: A Realm holding an enduring relationship and its shared history.
entries.usage: Use for Relationship Realm type recognition.

entries.name: Atlas
entries.category: Legacy library Scene asset › Atlas · current Pattern: Viewport
entries.meaning: The interface for orienting across Realms and their relationships.
entries.usage: Use as an interface term within the Scenes Domain, not as a new Field Element.

entries.name: Appointed
entries.category: Legacy or supplemental role asset › Appointed · not a named Role in Canon V0.28
entries.meaning: Carry a defined responsibility or authority granted through a visible appointment, with scope and duration that can be understood.
entries.usage: Use for the Appointed Role.

entries.name: Founder
entries.category: Legacy or supplemental role asset › Founder · not a named Role in Canon V0.28
entries.meaning: Hold a Realm's founding relationship to its purpose, formation, and earliest commitments without implying permanent unilateral control.
entries.usage: Use for the Founder Role.

entries.name: Role
entries.category: Legacy or supplemental role asset › Role · not a named Role in Canon V0.28
entries.meaning: A named pattern of responsibility, contribution, authority, and participation within a Realm.
entries.usage: Use for the concept of a Role; use the named Role sigils for Catalyst, Organizer, Creator, Builder, and Luminary.

entries.name: Commons
entries.meaning: A shared place whose life, value, and stewardship are held in common.
entries.usage: Use for Commons within the Scenes Domain.

entries.name: Exchange
entries.essence: Reciprocity — let value move both ways
entries.meaning: A place for reciprocal movement of value, knowledge, resources, or opportunity.
entries.usage: Use for Exchange within the Scenes Domain.

entries.name: Factory
entries.meaning: A place where inputs are deliberately transformed into coherent outputs.
entries.usage: Use for Factory within the Scenes Domain.

entries.name: Forum
entries.meaning: A bounded place for discussion, inquiry, and collective sensemaking.
entries.usage: Use for Forums and their participation boundaries within the Scenes Domain.

entries.name: Garden
entries.meaning: A living place shaped through patient care, seasons, and reciprocal growth.
entries.usage: Use for Garden within the Scenes Domain.

entries.name: Studio
entries.meaning: The surface where Realms, Scenes, intelligence, and artifacts are authored and governed.
entries.usage: Use for Studio entry points and authoring context within the Scenes Domain.

entries.name: Vault
entries.meaning: The out-of-app, web-only place-of-keeping for stewarded assets and records.
entries.usage: Use for Vault badge contexts outside the app; never classify Vault as a Scene.

entries.name: Alliance
entries.meaning: A Realm formed by distinct parties coordinating without losing identity.
entries.usage: Use for Alliance Realm type recognition.

entries.name: Cell
entries.essence: Agency — a small whole in motion
entries.meaning: A compact, bounded, autonomous Realm able to act independently while belonging to a larger living system.
entries.usage: Use for a small autonomous Realm nested within an Organization, Institution, or Ecosystem.

entries.name: Community
entries.meaning: A Realm where varied participants gather around shared belonging.
entries.usage: Use for Community Realm type recognition.

entries.name: Concept
entries.meaning: A Realm for unresolved ideas, inquiry, and emerging structure.
entries.usage: Use for Concept Realm type recognition.

entries.name: Ecosystem
entries.meaning: A privileged Realm form holding multiple distinct Realms, relationships, flows, habitats, and dependencies as one living system.
entries.usage: Use for an Ecosystem Realm whose scope or authority spans and relates multiple Realms.

entries.name: Institution
entries.meaning: A Realm whose purpose is carried through a durable mandate, enduring roles, governance, practice, and public memory.
entries.usage: Use for an Institution Realm when continuity of mandate and practice is central.

entries.name: Organization
entries.meaning: A Realm with durable institutional identity, roles, and shared purpose.
entries.usage: Use for Organization Realm type recognition in the Field and Atlas.

entries.name: Program
entries.meaning: A Realm for recurring work, participation, or delivery over time.
entries.usage: Use for Program Realm type recognition.

entries.name: Project
entries.meaning: A bounded Realm moving toward a defined result.
entries.usage: Use for Project Realm type recognition.

entries.name: Resources
entries.meaning: The canonical Element type for value, Compute, time, access, or materials in motion.
entries.usage: Use for Resources and their availability or consequence.

entries.name: $KIDUNA
entries.meaning: The specific compute-credit currency of Kinship Duna, distinct from generic Compute capacity.

sigils.meaning: The functional sigil for intelligence and AI: reasoning, learning, inference, agent behavior, and adaptive capability.
sigils.usage: Use for artificial intelligence, reasoning, learning, inference, agent behavior, and adaptive capability.

functional.usage: Use for artificial intelligence, reasoning, learning, inference, agent behavior, and adaptive capability.

sigils.name: Wind
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Functional sigils › Infrastructure / runtime
sigils.essence: Runtime — carry work through the system
sigils.meaning: The functional sigil for infrastructure and runtime: the operational systems that carry, host, connect, deploy, and sustain working software.
sigils.usage: Use for infrastructure, runtime, hosting, deployment, networking, compute, orchestration, and operational delivery.

functional.usage: Use for infrastructure, runtime, hosting, deployment, networking, compute, orchestration, and operational delivery.

sigils.name: Capacities
sigils.meaning: The Capacities Domain gateway to powers that Sources, Allies, Actors, and Realms can shape and activate.
sigils.usage: Use to browse or configure the canonical Capacity family.

sigils.name: Elements
sigils.meaning: The Elements Domain gateway to the seven canonical kinds of things visible in the Field.
sigils.usage: Use to browse Realms, Actions, Resources, Media, Allies, Actors, and Offers together.

sigils.name: Roles
sigils.meaning: The Roles Domain gateway to canonical patterns of contribution, responsibility, authority, and participation.
sigils.usage: Use to enter or browse the Roles Domain without implying one particular Role.

sigils.name: Scenes
sigils.meaning: The Scenes Domain gateway to situated, versioned experiences attached to Realms.
sigils.usage: Use to enter or browse the Scene collection without implying one Scene type.

sigils.name: Themes
sigils.meaning: The Themes Domain gateway to coherent visual, material, atmospheric, and symbolic expression.
sigils.usage: Use when selecting or shaping a Realm or Scene Theme.

sigils.name: Confirmed
sigils.meaning: The canonical lifecycle seal mark for confirmed context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for confirmed; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Draft
sigils.meaning: The canonical lifecycle seal mark for draft context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for draft; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Prepared
sigils.meaning: The canonical lifecycle seal mark for prepared context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for prepared; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Published
sigils.meaning: The canonical lifecycle seal mark for published context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for published; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Reversed
sigils.meaning: The canonical lifecycle seal mark for reversed context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for reversed; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Settled
sigils.meaning: The canonical lifecycle seal mark for settled context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for settled; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Unpublished
sigils.meaning: The canonical lifecycle seal mark for unpublished context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for unpublished; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Personal
sigils.meaning: The canonical privacy seal mark for personal context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for personal; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Private
sigils.essence: Bounded — visible to an explicit group
sigils.meaning: The canonical privacy seal mark for private context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for private; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Public
sigils.essence: Open — visible to the shared realm
sigils.meaning: The canonical privacy seal mark for public context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for public; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Secret
sigils.essence: Veiled — visible only under exceptional authority
sigils.meaning: The canonical privacy seal mark for secret context.
sigils.usage: Use as a compact product-context mark for secret; do not infer hidden human emotion or intent.

sigils.name: Archive
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Provisional organization signatures › Archive
sigils.meaning: An Organization signature centered on memory, continuity, and stewardship.
sigils.usage: Use as an Organization identity archetype.

sigils.name: Beacon
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Provisional organization signatures › Beacon
sigils.meaning: An Organization signature centered on trustworthy orientation.
sigils.usage: Use as an Organization identity archetype, not as a Realm type.

sigils.name: Bridge
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Provisional organization signatures › Bridge
sigils.meaning: An Organization signature centered on enabling safe passage.
sigils.usage: Use as an Organization identity archetype. In the Functional Sigil Set, Bridge identifies integration work and the reliable connection of systems, services, and handoffs.

functional.usage: In the Functional Sigil Set, Bridge identifies integration work and the reliable connection of systems, services, and handoffs.

sigils.name: Grove
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Provisional organization signatures › Grove
sigils.meaning: An Organization signature centered on patient cultivation.
sigils.usage: Use as an Organization identity archetype.

sigils.name: Loom
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Provisional organization signatures › Loom
sigils.meaning: An Organization signature centered on coordination and interdependence.
sigils.usage: Use as an Organization identity archetype. In the Functional Sigil Set, Loom identifies data and relationship work, including models, provenance, mappings, and flows.

functional.usage: In the Functional Sigil Set, Loom identifies data and relationship work, including models, provenance, mappings, and flows.

sigils.name: Pinnacle
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Provisional organization signatures › Pinnacle
sigils.meaning: An Organization signature centered on shared aspiration and direction.
sigils.usage: Use as an Organization identity archetype; distinct from the Summit talisman.

sigils.name: Compass
sigils.meaning: A portable symbol for orientation and direction.
sigils.usage: Use where a person or Actor needs to locate a meaningful way forward. In the Functional Sigil Set, Compass identifies product and design work, including product intent, experience architecture, and specification.

functional.usage: In the Functional Sigil Set, Compass identifies product and design work, including product intent, experience architecture, and specification.

sigils.name: Complementarity
sigils.essence: Complementarity — radiance and reflection belong together
sigils.meaning: The canonical unified sigil for The Sun and The Moon: generative warmth and reflective possibility held as one living celestial identity without collapse, hierarchy, or opposition.
sigils.usage: Use for Kiduna’s whole celestial identity, continuity across cycles, or contexts where radiance and reflection must be held together. Use The Sun or Moon when only one mode is intended.

sigils.name: Cowrie Shell
sigils.essence: Carried value — let worth move through relationship
sigils.meaning: The canonical Talisman for carried value: worth shaped, remembered, and made meaningful through relationship, passage, exchange, and continuity.
sigils.usage: Use for value carried across people, places, generations, or exchanges; portable memory; reciprocal passage; or worth whose meaning arises through relationship. Do not reduce Cowrie Shell to money, wealth, status, fertility, divination, luxury, or any single culture’s sacred or ceremonial use.

sigils.name: Earth
sigils.essence: Belonging — hold the living world in common
sigils.meaning: The canonical Talisman for shared living ground, planetary belonging, interdependence, stewardship, and the finite world that holds many forms of life.
sigils.usage: Use for planetary belonging, ecological interdependence, shared ground, finite conditions, collective home, or stewardship across generations. Do not use as an emblem of ownership, nationalism, territorial claims, environmental branding, or a generic worldwide or internet icon.

sigils.name: Eclipse
sigils.meaning: A portable symbol for convergence, temporary veiling, liminal transition, and the return of radiance.
sigils.usage: Use for rare transitions, temporary occlusion, and transformational passages without treating darkness as failure.

sigils.name: Flower
sigils.meaning: The canonical Talisman for flourishing: living potential becoming visible, mature, generous, and available for relationship.
sigils.usage: Use for cultivated possibility opening into presence, visible aliveness, maturity, generosity, invitation, nourishment, renewal, or the transition from emergence to bloom. Do not use for romance, courtship, femininity, purity, beauty standards, luxury, fragility, mourning, a specific religion, or passive decoration. In the Functional Sigil Set, Flower identifies experience and polish work, including usability, sensory quality, refinement, and finish.

functional.usage: In the Functional Sigil Set, Flower identifies experience and polish work, including usability, sensory quality, refinement, and finish.

sigils.name: Light
sigils.meaning: The canonical sigil for Light as relationship made manifest. Light is not urged forward and does not conquer the Void; it follows the universe’s deepest rule, already written in the language of light.
sigils.usage: Use for illumination, emergence through relation, coherence revealed, or possibility becoming legible. Do not reduce Light to speed, emission, victory over darkness, or a weapon.

sigils.name: Moon
sigils.meaning: A portable symbol for reflection, rest, and unforced possibility.
sigils.usage: Use for reflective or dreaming states without implying inactivity.

sigils.name: Photon
sigils.meaning: The canonical unified sigil for How? and Wow!: one photon held as both precise particle and living wave, expressing complementarity as an operating condition rather than two opposing symbols.
sigils.usage: Use when inquiry and astonishment, precision and possibility, or point and field must be held together as one living act. Never split How? and Wow! into adjacent or independent marks.

sigils.name: Saturn
sigils.essence: Structure — honor the shape of time
sigils.meaning: The canonical Talisman for structure across time: enduring cycles, appropriate boundaries, patience, consequence, maturity, and the beauty of finite form.
sigils.usage: Use for long cycles, durable structure, patient formation, appropriate limits, consequences that unfold over time, or maturity earned through sustained practice. Do not use for punishment, oppression, imprisonment, rigidity, command, dominance, hierarchy, fatalism, scarcity, astrology, or a deity.

sigils.name: Sprout
sigils.meaning: A portable symbol for early growth and careful cultivation.
sigils.usage: Use for beginnings, nurturing, and emerging work.

sigils.name: Star
sigils.essence: Orientation — keep a living course true
sigils.meaning: The canonical Talisman for constancy, distant guidance, orientation, and the steady point by which a living course can remain true.
sigils.usage: Use for navigation by enduring principle, long-horizon orientation, a constant reference across change, or guidance that illuminates without commanding. Do not use as an emblem of fame, rank, achievement, rating, celebrity, hierarchy, or generic decoration.

sigils.name: Summit
sigils.meaning: A portable symbol for chosen purpose and a visible horizon.
sigils.usage: Use for directed progress toward an acknowledged aim.

sigils.name: The Sun
sigils.meaning: A portable symbol for illumination, warmth, wakefulness, renewal, and generative vitality.
sigils.usage: Use for emergence, visibility, renewal, or purposeful activation without implying surveillance or dominance.

sigils.name: Tide
sigils.meaning: A portable symbol for flow, cadence, and adaptive movement.
sigils.usage: Use where timing and rhythm matter more than force.

sigils.name: Vessel
sigils.meaning: A portable symbol for holding, protecting, and carrying value.
sigils.usage: Use for stewardship, custody, and intentional containment.

sigils.name: Void
sigils.essence: Possibility — hold the condition of becoming
sigils.meaning: The canonical sigil for the receptive condition from which Light—and eventually matter, time, and relationship—can emerge. Void is not an opposing force to Light, nor absence as failure.
sigils.usage: Use for generative emptiness, unformed possibility, quiet receptivity, or conditions prior to relation. Do not treat Void as evil, destructive darkness, or a defeated opposite.

sigils.name: Bear
sigils.essence: Grounded strength — protect what must endure
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for protective presence, embodied courage, patient strength, restorative withdrawal, and the power to hold a boundary without aggression.
sigils.usage: Use for guardianship, resilience, grounded courage, deep rest, restoration, or firm compassionate boundaries. Do not use as a sports mascot, heraldic threat, generic power icon, or emblem of domination.

sigils.name: Bee
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for devoted contribution, mutual flourishing, interdependence, and collective intelligence: one living agent carrying possibility between communities.
sigils.usage: Use for pollination, distributed contribution, coordinated care, reciprocal ecosystems, and work whose value emerges through relationship. Do not use as a generic insect, mascot, hive brand, or symbol of obedience.

sigils.name: Butterfly
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Totems › Butterfly · library asset; not yet named in Canon V0.28
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for becoming: changing form while carrying continuity forward through transformation, emergence, migration, release, and new capacity.
sigils.usage: Use for transformation, emergence, migration, adaptation, release into new capacity, or continuity through a change of form. Do not use for beauty standards, femininity, fragility, vanity, romance, passive decoration, self-erasure, escape from responsibility, instant reinvention, death, resurrection doctrine, or the claim that change always improves a person.

sigils.name: Dragon
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Totems › Dragon · library asset; not yet named in Canon V0.28
sigils.essence: Disciplined vitality — let great power protect what may become
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for great living power made protective, generative, accountable, and available to relationship through disciplined vitality.
sigils.usage: Use for immense capacity held with restraint, protective power, governed vitality, accountable force, generative guardianship, or strength serving emergence. Do not use for conquest, domination, aggression, hoarding, wealth, fire, war, hierarchy, supremacy, fantasy power, or any specific culture’s sacred dragon tradition.

sigils.name: Firefly
sigils.essence: Living light — make the nearby world visible
sigils.meaning: The canonical sigil for living light held by a small earthly body: gentle guidance, emergence, shared wonder, and the power of a modest light to reveal a living field.
sigils.usage: Use for quiet guidance, embodied illumination, small beginnings, distributed possibility, or life making its immediate world legible. Do not use as a generic insect, celestial star, abstract Light, or Photon.

sigils.name: Fox
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for adaptive intelligence, careful navigation, resourcefulness, responsiveness to changing conditions, and finding a viable path through complexity.
sigils.usage: Use for adaptation, strategic navigation, responsive problem-solving, resourcefulness, or reading a changing landscape. Do not use as an emblem of deceit, manipulation, predation, slyness, or winning at another’s expense.

sigils.name: Octopus
sigils.essence: Coordination — sense through many, remain one
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for distributed intelligence, adaptive coordination, embodied dexterity, curiosity, and sensing and acting through many points while remaining one coherent being.
sigils.usage: Use for distributed sensing, multi-channel coordination, adaptive problem-solving, dexterity, parallel action, or many capabilities cohering around one purpose. Do not use as an emblem of control, manipulation, entanglement, surveillance, grasping power, or monstrosity.

sigils.name: Owl
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for patient observation, silent attention, discernment in darkness, and the ability to perceive relationships hidden from ordinary view.
sigils.usage: Use for reflection, careful witnessing, pattern recognition, nocturnal awareness, or understanding that emerges through still attention. Do not use as a school seal, surveillance mark, generic intelligence icon, mascot, or emblem of judgment.

sigils.name: Prairie Dog
sigils.category: Designs › Iconography › Totems › Prairie Dog · library asset; not yet named in Canon V0.28
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for attentive community, distributed watchfulness, timely signals, and the safety made possible when connected neighbors remain aware of one another.
sigils.usage: Use for shared vigilance, neighborly attention, reciprocal warning, distributed awareness, community safety, connected communication, or alert participation in a living network. Do not use for paranoia, fear, panic, gossip, surveillance, policing, control, territorial aggression, conformity, hierarchy, pest status, or self-sacrifice.

sigils.name: Rabbit
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for alert possibility, quick emergence, generative abundance, and the wisdom to pause, listen, and move when the path opens.
sigils.usage: Use for fertile beginnings, multiplying possibility, sensitive timing, nimble response, or quiet readiness. Do not use as a pet mascot, Easter symbol, zodiac mark, generic speed icon, or emblem of fear.

sigils.name: Stag
sigils.essence: Renewal — let leadership become a living canopy
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for regenerative leadership, dignified presence, seasonal renewal, stewardship, and holding many branching paths as one living crown.
sigils.usage: Use for leadership that creates conditions for others to grow, stewardship across seasons, renewed purpose, dignified presence, or holding divergent paths in a coherent whole. Do not use as an emblem of dominance, conquest, hunting, hierarchy, royalty, aggression, or masculinity.

sigils.name: Turtle
sigils.meaning: The canonical Totem for patient continuity, embodied resilience, durable memory, protection without isolation, and carrying home through change.
sigils.usage: Use for long journeys, stewardship across generations, resilient continuity, patient progress, durable memory, or protection that remains open to relationship. Do not use as an emblem of slowness, fear, retreat, passive endurance, isolation, or racing against others.

sigils.name: Agreement
sigils.meaning: An Offer whose terms have been accepted and now bind the participating parties.
sigils.usage: Use when acceptance, terms, parties, and effective state are all recorded.

sigils.name: Fail
sigils.essence: Not adopted — the threshold remains closed
sigils.meaning: The negative canonical outcome of a vote or governed trade.
sigils.usage: Use as the sibling opposite of Pass after an outcome is final.

sigils.name: Pass
sigils.meaning: The affirmative canonical outcome of a vote or governed trade.
sigils.usage: Use as the sibling opposite of Fail after an outcome is final.

sigils.name: Policy
sigils.meaning: A governing rule with defined authority, scope, and effect.
sigils.usage: Use for policy-bearing decisions and the boundaries they establish.

sigils.name: Proposal
sigils.essence: Possibility — place a course before the group
sigils.meaning: A specific course of action formally presented for consideration.
sigils.usage: Use before collective decision, preserving proposer, terms, and revision history.

sigils.name: Governance
sigils.meaning: The structures through which collective authority and policy are formed.
sigils.usage: Use for governance processes and policy-bearing decisions.

sigils.name: Treasury
sigils.meaning: A governed vessel for shared value, allocation, and accountability.
sigils.usage: Use for Treasury custody and value-flow consequences.

sigils.name: Wallet
sigils.meaning: A personal or delegated container for value and credentials.
sigils.usage: Use for Wallet identity, balance, and authorization context.

sigils.name: Actors
sigils.meaning: The canonical Element type for intelligent presences that can participate and act.
sigils.usage: Use for Actors; Ki orchestrates but is not itself a Field Element.

sigils.name: Envoy
sigils.meaning: An Actor type authorized to represent a Realm or party in another context.
sigils.usage: Use when an Actor carries bounded delegated intent between Realms.

sigils.name: Operator
sigils.meaning: An Actor type that directly operates a defined system under granted authority.
sigils.usage: Use for an Actor carrying active operating responsibility.

sigils.name: Sentinel
sigils.meaning: A vigilant protective presence enforcing a defined boundary or policy.
sigils.usage: Use for Sentinels, guarded thresholds, and policy attention.

sigils.name: Supervisor
sigils.meaning: An Actor type that observes, coordinates, and intervenes across delegated work under policy.
sigils.usage: Use for explicit supervisory responsibility; never imply hidden surveillance.

sigils.name: Worker
sigils.meaning: An Actor type configured to perform repeatable or delegated work within explicit limits.
sigils.usage: Use for task-performing Actors whose scope and tools are visible.

sigils.name: Allies
sigils.meaning: Intelligent companions shaped by Sources or Realms to understand context, collaborate, advise, create, and act within defined permissions.
sigils.usage: Use for Allies as distinct intelligent Elements. An Ally may have a portrait representation, but is not a Source or the Avatar that represents a Source.

sigils.name: Dreaming
sigils.essence: Imagining, incubating, reflecting, or exploring possibility.
sigils.meaning: The canonical portrait-state marker for Dreaming: Imagining, incubating, reflecting, or exploring possibility.
sigils.usage: Use to present an explicitly selected Dreaming state for an Ally or Avatar portrait. Do not infer private emotion, hidden activity, Consent, Role, Permission, or Authority.

sigils.name: Engaged
sigils.meaning: The canonical portrait-state marker for Engaged: Actively conversing, collaborating, or responding.
sigils.usage: Use to present an explicitly selected Engaged state for an Ally or Avatar portrait. Do not infer private emotion, hidden activity, Consent, Role, Permission, or Authority.

sigils.name: Focused
sigils.meaning: The canonical portrait-state marker for Focused: Deliberately working, reviewing, or making.
sigils.usage: Use to present an explicitly selected Focused state for an Ally or Avatar portrait. Do not infer private emotion, hidden activity, Consent, Role, Permission, or Authority.

sigils.name: Open
sigils.meaning: The canonical portrait-state marker for Open: Available, welcoming, and present.
sigils.usage: Use to present an explicitly selected Open state for an Ally or Avatar portrait. Do not infer private emotion, hidden activity, Consent, Role, Permission, or Authority.

sigils.name: Ki
sigils.meaning: The coordinating intelligence that helps Actors and systems work together.
sigils.usage: Use for Ki orchestration; never present Ki as a Field Element.

sigils.name: Media
sigils.meaning: The canonical Element type for created, attached, or verification-bearing Media.
sigils.usage: Use for Media including Scenes and Records.

sigils.name: Record
sigils.meaning: Verification-bearing Media produced by a meaningful Action.
sigils.usage: Use for receipts, provenance, decisions, and recovery history.

sigils.name: Realms
sigils.meaning: The canonical Element type for purposeful worlds and their boundaries.
sigils.usage: Use as the generic Realms Element type, not as a specific Realm form.

sigils.name: Source
sigils.meaning: The human origin of identity, permission, and representation in Kiduna.
sigils.usage: Use where human authority must be distinguished from the Ally shown in the Field.

sigils.name: Actions
sigils.category: Legacy library Element asset › Actions · not an Element in Canon V0.28
sigils.meaning: The canonical Element type for consequential or recorded change.
sigils.usage: Use for Actions across proposal, authorization, execution, and receipt.

sigils.name: Offers
sigils.category: Legacy library Element asset › Offers · not an Element in Canon V0.28
sigils.meaning: The seventh canonical Element type: a proposed exchange, opportunity, or contribution with understandable terms.
sigils.usage: Use for Offers as a Field Element before acceptance or binding Agreement.

sigils.name: Live
sigils.category: Legacy library Mode asset › Live · current Modes are Forge, Rehearse, and Field
sigils.meaning: The Live mode in which eligible published Scene packages become present.
sigils.usage: Use for Live mode and Studio-to-Live continuity; Live is not a Surface taxonomy.

sigils.name: Relationship
sigils.category: Legacy library Realm form › Relationship · current Realm form: Dyad
sigils.meaning: A Realm holding an enduring relationship and its shared history.
sigils.usage: Use for Relationship Realm type recognition.

sigils.name: Atlas
sigils.category: Legacy library Scene asset › Atlas · current Pattern: Viewport
sigils.meaning: The interface for orienting across Realms and their relationships.
sigils.usage: Use as an interface term within the Scenes Domain, not as a new Field Element.

sigils.name: Appointed
sigils.category: Legacy or supplemental role asset › Appointed · not a named Role in Canon V0.28
sigils.meaning: Carry a defined responsibility or authority granted through a visible appointment, with scope and duration that can be understood.
sigils.usage: Use for the Appointed Role.

sigils.name: Founder
sigils.category: Legacy or supplemental role asset › Founder · not a named Role in Canon V0.28
sigils.meaning: Hold a Realm's founding relationship to its purpose, formation, and earliest commitments without implying permanent unilateral control.
sigils.usage: Use for the Founder Role.

sigils.name: Role
sigils.category: Legacy or supplemental role asset › Role · not a named Role in Canon V0.28
sigils.meaning: A named pattern of responsibility, contribution, authority, and participation within a Realm.
sigils.usage: Use for the concept of a Role; use the named Role sigils for Catalyst, Organizer, Creator, Builder, and Luminary.

sigils.name: Commons
sigils.meaning: A shared place whose life, value, and stewardship are held in common.
sigils.usage: Use for Commons within the Scenes Domain.

sigils.name: Exchange
sigils.essence: Reciprocity — let value move both ways
sigils.meaning: A place for reciprocal movement of value, knowledge, resources, or opportunity.
sigils.usage: Use for Exchange within the Scenes Domain.

sigils.name: Factory
sigils.meaning: A place where inputs are deliberately transformed into coherent outputs.
sigils.usage: Use for Factory within the Scenes Domain.

sigils.name: Forum
sigils.meaning: A bounded place for discussion, inquiry, and collective sensemaking.
sigils.usage: Use for Forums and their participation boundaries within the Scenes Domain.

sigils.name: Garden
sigils.meaning: A living place shaped through patient care, seasons, and reciprocal growth.
sigils.usage: Use for Garden within the Scenes Domain.

sigils.name: Studio
sigils.meaning: The surface where Realms, Scenes, intelligence, and artifacts are authored and governed.
sigils.usage: Use for Studio entry points and authoring context within the Scenes Domain.

sigils.name: Vault
sigils.meaning: The out-of-app, web-only place-of-keeping for stewarded assets and records.
sigils.usage: Use for Vault badge contexts outside the app; never classify Vault as a Scene.

sigils.name: Alliance
sigils.meaning: A Realm formed by distinct parties coordinating without losing identity.
sigils.usage: Use for Alliance Realm type recognition.

sigils.name: Cell
sigils.essence: Agency — a small whole in motion
sigils.meaning: A compact, bounded, autonomous Realm able to act independently while belonging to a larger living system.
sigils.usage: Use for a small autonomous Realm nested within an Organization, Institution, or Ecosystem.

sigils.name: Community
sigils.meaning: A Realm where varied participants gather around shared belonging.
sigils.usage: Use for Community Realm type recognition.

sigils.name: Concept
sigils.meaning: A Realm for unresolved ideas, inquiry, and emerging structure.
sigils.usage: Use for Concept Realm type recognition.

sigils.name: Ecosystem
sigils.meaning: A privileged Realm form holding multiple distinct Realms, relationships, flows, habitats, and dependencies as one living system.
sigils.usage: Use for an Ecosystem Realm whose scope or authority spans and relates multiple Realms.

sigils.name: Institution
sigils.meaning: A Realm whose purpose is carried through a durable mandate, enduring roles, governance, practice, and public memory.
sigils.usage: Use for an Institution Realm when continuity of mandate and practice is central.

sigils.name: Organization
sigils.meaning: A Realm with durable institutional identity, roles, and shared purpose.
sigils.usage: Use for Organization Realm type recognition in the Field and Atlas.

sigils.name: Program
sigils.meaning: A Realm for recurring work, participation, or delivery over time.
sigils.usage: Use for Program Realm type recognition.

sigils.name: Project
sigils.meaning: A bounded Realm moving toward a defined result.
sigils.usage: Use for Project Realm type recognition.

sigils.name: Resources
sigils.meaning: The canonical Element type for value, Compute, time, access, or materials in motion.
sigils.usage: Use for Resources and their availability or consequence.

sigils.name: $KIDUNA
sigils.meaning: The specific compute-credit currency of Kinship Duna, distinct from generic Compute capacity.
sigils.usage: Use for balances, transfers, and allocations denominated in Kinship Duna compute credit.

sigils.name: Compute
sigils.meaning: Generic computational capacity available to power Actors, automations, and other work.
sigils.usage: Use for measurable compute capacity without implying a currency or account.

sigils.name: Invitation
sigils.meaning: A personal Kinship Code invitation passed deliberately from one person to another.
sigils.usage: Use for the canonical onboarding object; preserve its personal origin and chain of trust.

sigils.name: Builder
sigils.meaning: Create the apps, agents, tools, automations, systems, and infrastructure that expand what an organization can do. Builders make valuable work easier to perform, repeat, improve, share, and extend into entirely new forms of individual and collective agency.
sigils.usage: Use for the Builder Role.

sigils.name: Catalyst
sigils.meaning: Bring a project, program, or organization into being. Catalysts clarify the initial purpose, gather the founding participants, assemble the necessary resources, and carry an emerging idea through formation and into motion.
sigils.usage: Use for the Catalyst Role.

sigils.name: Creator
sigils.meaning: Turn knowledge, imagination, and lived experience into living capabilities. Creators add wisdom, shape an organization’s presence, design its stories and experiences, train its allies, and create the instructions, media, methods, and processes through which its purpose becomes real.
sigils.usage: Use for the Creator Role.

sigils.name: Guest
sigils.meaning: Participate through a limited, legible invitation without assuming the responsibilities or authority of membership.
sigils.usage: Use for the Guest Role.

sigils.name: Luminary
sigils.essence: Depth — ground a collective in defining work
sigils.meaning: Contribute a defining work, body of wisdom, creative practice, or deep intellectual grounding around which a collective can form and grow. Luminaries may be supported through project budgets, royalties, repayment of development costs, or allocations established by the organization.
sigils.usage: Use for the Luminary Role.

sigils.name: Member
sigils.meaning: Belong to a Realm through recognized participation, reciprocal responsibility, and access appropriate to membership.
sigils.usage: Use for the Member Role.

sigils.name: Organizer
sigils.meaning: Form and sustain the relationships that make collective action possible. Organizers bring people together around a shared purpose, help them find their place, and nurture the participation and activity that grow through the communities they support.
sigils.usage: Use for the Organizer Role.
